title: SECP Phase II reporting window opens
summary: Phase II PSX-listed companies report from July 2026; Phase III and other public interest companies from July 2027.
paras: Phase II PSX-listed companies report from July 2026. Phase III and other public interest companies follow from July 2027. Assurance follows from the second year of reporting.

For most teams the first filing is a data problem before it is a writing problem. Start by listing which disclosures you can already support with evidence, and which depend on data you do not yet collect.
A free QuickScan is a short diagnostic that shows where you stand against IFRS S1/S2 before you commit to a full assessment.

title: Ready for your EU buyers' CBAM and CSRD questions?
summary: Seven boxes to work through before your EU buyers come asking: scope, buyers, the value-chain cap, and your response protocol.
paras: Pakistani exporters selling into the EU are increasingly asked for sustainability data by their buyers. The questions arrive through procurement, often with short deadlines.
The CBAM / CSRD readiness checklist is an interactive, tickable list covering scope, your buyers, the value-chain cap, and how you will respond when a request lands.

title: GRI and IFRS S1/S2 answer different questions
summary: GRI asks what effect a company has on the world. IFRS S1/S2 ask what effect sustainability has on the company.
paras: GRI and IFRS S1/S2 are not competing versions of the same standard. GRI is built around impact materiality. IFRS S1 and S2 are built around financial materiality.
Many companies need both, so the useful question is where the two overlap and where each asks for something the other does not.

title: What a first sustainability assurance engagement looks like
summary: ISAE 3000 and ISAE 3410 explained for teams about to go through their first engagement.
paras: Assurance on sustainability information follows from the second year of reporting for many Pakistani companies. Teams that prepare early find the first engagement far less disruptive.
The article walks through what ISAE 3000 and ISAE 3410 ask for, and the evidence, controls and traceability an auditor will expect to see.

title: AI in ESG disclosure: what CSRD, ISSB and California now require
summary: How AI is used across the disclosure lifecycle, and what assurance-ready reporting needs.
paras: AI is now used at several stages of the disclosure lifecycle, from data collection to drafting. Each use raises its own questions about evidence and review.
The guide sets out how to keep AI-assisted disclosure audit-ready, and what CSRD, ISSB and California now require.

title: Free course: Understanding GRI & IFRS S1/S2
summary: Ten lessons with worksheets, assignments and a final assessment that unlocks a certificate.
paras: The course covers how GRI and IFRS S1/S2 differ, how materiality works under each, how a GRI report is built, and how each IFRS S1/S2 disclosure is structured.
It includes a worksheet for every lesson, six multiple-choice assignments, and a 40-question final assessment that unlocks a certificate at 70%. It is free with sign-up.
